from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json

out=Path('docs/evidence/joss')
trans=json.loads((out/'2026-09-11-checkpoint35-candidate47-transitions.json').read_text())
roots=[Path(p) for p in trans['roots']]
rows=[];counts=Counter()
for change in trans['changed_outcomes']:
    rel=Path('cases')/change['case_id']/change['variant']/'comparison.json'
    a,b=[json.loads((root/rel).read_text()) for root in roots]
    before=Path(a['neospice']['stderr']['path']).read_text()
    after=Path(b['neospice']['stderr']['path']).read_text()
    if a['neospice']['failure_class']=='parse_error' and b['neospice']['ok']:
        if b['status']=='MATCH':category='VDMOS binding repaired; minimal OP comparison matches'
        elif not b['reference']['ok']:category='Native parser now succeeds; reference still fails, no accuracy claim'
        else:category='Native parser now succeeds; numerical discrepancy remains'
    else:category='Needs further investigation'
    counts[category]+=1
    rows.append(dict(change,classification=category,before_native_stderr=before,after_native_stderr=after,
        reference_result_unchanged=all(a['reference'][k]==b['reference'][k] for k in ['ok','failure_class','returncode','values']),
        current_reference_stderr=Path(b['reference']['stderr']['path']).read_text()))
report=dict(checkpoint=35,reference_version='47',outcome_changes=len(rows),classifications=dict(counts),cases=rows,
    limitations=['All fixtures and original tolerances retained.',
        'The stronger VT6K1 temperature/bias diagnostic fails despite its minimal OP matches. Model-expression and global-model scoping diagnostics are retained separately.',
        'No declaration-level or full-analysis certification from these minimal fixtures.'],generation_script=Path(__file__).read_text())
p=out/'2026-09-11-checkpoint35-transition-triage.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(outcome_changes=len(rows),classifications=dict(counts),unclassified=[r['identity'] for r in rows if r['classification']=='Needs further investigation']),indent=2))
